## IStoryContent type

Story content accepted by [Ctx.postBusinessStory()](./gramstax.ctx.postbusinessstory.md) and [Ctx.editBusinessStory()](./gramstax.ctx.editbusinessstory.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IStoryContent = {
    type: `photo` | `video`;
    src: string | InputFile | Buffer | Uint8Array;
    duration?: number | null;
};
```

## Remarks

Photo or video only; `src` resolves through [Ctx.resolveMedia()](./gramstax.ctx.resolvemedia.md) then converts to an upload (`InputFile` as-is, URLs via `{url}`<!-- -->); residual strings are `file_id` values the Bot API resolves server-side (the installed typings only model uploads, hence one narrow documented cast). Areas and captions ride on `options`<!-- -->; duration rules beyond presence are adjudicated by the Bot API.
